product_plans_cost_check.name: product_plans_cost_check
product_plans_cost_check.value: ("product_plans"."target_cost_amount" is null and "product_plans"."target_cost_currency" is null) or ("product_plans"."target_cost_amount" >= 0 and "product_plans"."target_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

skus_cost_check.name: skus_cost_check
skus_cost_check.value: ("skus"."unit_cost_amount" is null and "skus"."unit_cost_currency" is null) or ("skus"."unit_cost_amount" >= 0 and "skus"."unit_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

supplier_candidates_cost_check.name: supplier_candidates_cost_check
supplier_candidates_cost_check.value: ("supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_amount" is null and "supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_currency" is null) or ("supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_amount" >= 0 and "supplier_candidates"."quoted_cost_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

marketplace_publication_requests_followu.name: marketplace_publication_requests_followup_check
marketplace_publication_requests_followu.value: ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" in ('amazon_validation_preview', 'etsy_create_draft') and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is null) or ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" = 'amazon_submit' and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is not null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is null) or ("marketplace_publication_requests"."action" = 'etsy_activate' and "marketplace_publication_requests"."parent_request_id" is not null and "marketplace_publication_requests"."source_external_listing_id" is not null)

order_ingestion_runs_counts_check.name: order_ingestion_runs_counts_check
order_ingestion_runs_counts_check.value: "order_ingestion_runs"."collected_count" >= 0 and ("order_ingestion_runs"."reported_count" is null or "order_ingestion_runs"."reported_count" >= 0) and "order_ingestion_runs"."duplicate_count" >= 0 and "order_ingestion_runs"."risk_count" >= 0

order_line_catalog_links_target_check.name: order_line_catalog_links_target_check
order_line_catalog_links_target_check.value: "order_line_catalog_links"."sku_id" is not null or ("order_line_catalog_links"."listing_id" is not null and "order_line_catalog_links"."listing_version_id" is not null)

order_routing_decision_events_override_r.name: order_routing_decision_events_override_reason_check
order_routing_decision_events_override_r.value: "order_routing_decision_events"."type" <> 'overridden' or ("order_routing_decision_events"."supplier_id" is not null and "order_routing_decision_events"."reason_code" is not null and "order_routing_decision_events"."reason" is not null)

order_routing_decisions_selection_check.name: order_routing_decisions_selection_check
order_routing_decisions_selection_check.value: ("order_routing_decisions"."status" = 'no_eligible_supplier' and "order_routing_decisions"."selected_supplier_id" is null) or ("order_routing_decisions"."status" <> 'no_eligible_supplier' and "order_routing_decisions"."selected_supplier_id" is not null)

production_orders_parent_check.name: production_orders_parent_check
production_orders_parent_check.value: ("production_orders"."source" = 'initial' and "production_orders"."parent_production_order_id" is null) or ("production_orders"."source" = 'remake' and "production_orders"."parent_production_order_id" is not null)

production_recovery_cases_compensation_c.name: production_recovery_cases_compensation_check
production_recovery_cases_compensation_c.value: ("production_recovery_cases"."type" = 'cancellation_compensation' and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_amount_minor" is not null and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$') or ("production_recovery_cases"."type" <> 'cancellation_compensation' and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_amount_minor" is null and "production_recovery_cases"."compensation_currency" is null)

shipment_packages_money_check.name: shipment_packages_money_check
shipment_packages_money_check.value: ("shipment_packages"."label_cost_minor" is null and "shipment_packages"."label_currency" is null) or ("shipment_packages"."label_cost_minor" >= 0 and "shipment_packages"."label_currency" ~ '^[A-Z]{3}$')

shipment_packages_dimensions_check.name: shipment_packages_dimensions_check
shipment_packages_dimensions_check.value: ("shipment_packages"."length_mm" is null and "shipment_packages"."width_mm" is null and "shipment_packages"."height_mm" is null) or ("shipment_packages"."length_mm" > 0 and "shipment_packages"."width_mm" > 0 and "shipment_packages"."height_mm" > 0)

shipment_versions_delivery_check.name: shipment_versions_delivery_check
shipment_versions_delivery_check.value: ("shipment_versions"."promised_delivery_at" is null or "shipment_versions"."promised_delivery_at" >= "shipment_versions"."ship_date") and ("shipment_versions"."estimated_delivery_at" is null or "shipment_versions"."estimated_delivery_at" >= "shipment_versions"."ship_date")
